headline: Sensex and Nifty Rally Led by Foreign Inflows, Q2 Earnings, and Financial Gains

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Foreign institutional investor (FII/FPI) inflows continue to drive strong market sentiment and push indices higher.
Lower crude oil prices and positive cues from Asian markets provided additional support to early trade.
Strong Q2 profit performance in select companies boosted individual stock momentum.
Sectoral buying led by financials, autos, and cigarette stocks fueled benchmark gains.
whatHappening: Sensex rose over 400 points and Nifty topped 25,300 in morning trade on November 12.
ITC hiked Gold Flake Premium prices for the second time in 2026, triggering a rally in cigarette stocks.
Edelweiss Vice Chairman Venkatachalam Ramaswamy resigned and sought exit from the promoter category.
Motilal Oswal reiterated a bullish stance on Tata Power following a coal-led Q2 boost, projecting a 22% upside.
summary: Indian benchmark indices Sensex and Nifty extended gains on November 12, supported by strong FPI inflows and lower oil prices. Cupid hit a 52-week high after reported Q2 profit growth, while ITC rallied following cigarette price hikes. Edelweiss saw executive changes with the resignation of its Vice Chairman.
